name: Config Warning
description: Shows a configurable warning message on admin forms that are likely to alter the site's running configuration.
project_description:
Provides a configurable warning on admin forms that are likely to alter the running configuration of the site.

 Features 
 You are able to enabled/disable the warning for periods when you are actively developing and alter the text to include, maybe, team policies around config changes.

 Post-Installation 
 Once installed, a config page is created at admin/config/development/config-warning and you can set/enable the message there. The message is disabled by default.

 Similar projects 
 The Configuration Override Warn module does far more but, as they say, installing that on production might be unwise.
